model.form: y = a + b*pdf_bytes + c*pages (b, c >= 0), fitted on full-document WASI runs

pdq.wasm.note: rebuilds byte-identically from this branch; PR #13 v3 module

flpdf-native.exe.note: final build; the native-small/native-large runs used the preceding build without the lean route (same library route; identical set digests)

pdq-native.exe.note: pdq-wasi built natively = pdq 0.5.1 with its own mmap loader

flpdf_reuse_investigation.finding: extract_pages reuses the parsed objects and the cached page list, but calls PageDocumentHelper::push_inherited_attributes_to_pages on every call, which walks the whole page tree (O(document pages) per chunk, in memory, no repeated I/O).
flpdf_reuse_investigation.evidence_source_code: flpdf-0.10.0 src/page_extract.rs extract_pages -> push_inherited_attributes_to_pages -> optimization::inherited_attrs::push (full walk); pages::page_refs uses page_list_cache
flpdf_reuse_investigation.push_probe_note: single diagnostic runs with FLPDF_PROBE_PUSH=1 (one extra push timed before each chunk); not part of runs.jsonl
flpdf_reuse_investigation.lean_route: FLPDF_EXTRACT=lean: same public-API steps (Pdf::empty, copy_foreign_object, /Parent, /Kids, /Count) with one push per batch; falls back to extract_pages when the source has /PageLabels
flpdf_reuse_investigation.lean_byte_identity: every chunk identical to the library route: s1000 25/25, s10000 250/250, t30000 750/750 (native), and identical set digests native/WASI for s1000, s10000, t30000, s30000

node_memory_after_ready.observation: the Bacalhau node's sampled RSS jumps within ~1 s of the worker writing ready, by ~160-180 MiB at s30000 (1.19 GB of chunks), ~16 MiB at t30000 (20 MB), ~4 MiB at s10000 (pre-sized/default modules alike); guest linear memory did not grow (pre-sized 128 MiB)
